implementationChallengesAndSolutions.description: Multiple new systems created potential for unexpected interactions and conflicts.
implementationChallengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented a phased integration approach starting with core components, then progressively adding advanced features with comprehensive testing at each stage.

implementationChallengesAndSolutions.description: Aggressive token optimization risked reducing output quality or completeness.
implementationChallengesAndSolutions.solution: Established comprehensive benchmarks for different operation types, ensuring optimization didn't compromise quality. Created balanced optimization strategies with clear metrics.

implementationChallengesAndSolutions.description: Unclear boundaries between different agent roles could lead to inconsistent outputs or duplication of effort.
implementationChallengesAndSolutions.solution: Created detailed role descriptions with clear responsibilities, integration points, and evaluation metrics. Developed templates for agent handoffs and collaboration.

implementationChallengesAndSolutions.description: Monitoring systems added performance overhead to development workflows.
implementationChallengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented selective monitoring with configurable levels of detail. Created batched reporting to reduce overhead during critical development operations.
